run.procedureSummary: Feed: add the cycle's feed row to each chamber, PUPAL chambers included, without regard to limits. Carry forward: one pass over chambers 1 to 6 in order; if a chamber is over its limit it is set to the limit and the excess goes into the next chamber before that chamber is checked, so overflow can cascade; the excess from chamber 6 is discarded and counted as loss. State check: using the amounts after carry forward, a LARVAL chamber at or above its upper mark becomes PUPAL, a PUPAL chamber at or below its lower mark becomes LARVAL, any other chamber keeps its state, and every change is logged. Metabolise: all shares are worked out from the amounts and states after the state check, before anything moves. A LARVAL chamber's share is floor(q/4), burned off and counted as loss. A PUPAL chamber's share is floor(q/2), moved to the chamber before it; for chamber 1 that share is discarded and counted as loss. All shares are then applied at the same time. No carry forward follows, so a chamber can end the step over its limit. Moult: if the line total after metabolise is strictly over 38, each chamber keeps floor(q/2) and the rest is discarded and counted as loss; states do not change. At 38 or less nothing happens. Arithmetic was done with a short Python script, C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\Temp\om\desk-250\run.py. I also checked cycle 1 by hand and it matches.

openPoints.point: Carry forward when overflow lands in a chamber that is then itself over its limit
openPoints.assumption: It cascades in the same 1-to-6 pass: the next chamber is checked after it has received the overflow, so the excess can travel several chambers in one step.

openPoints.point: Which amounts the state check uses
openPoints.assumption: The amounts after carry forward in the same cycle.
As written: equal to the upper mark counts as at or above (LARVAL goes PUPAL), and equal to the lower mark counts as at or below (PUPAL goes LARVAL).

openPoints.point: Which state and amount set the metabolise shares
openPoints.assumption: The state just after this cycle's state check (so a chamber that just changed uses its new state) and the amount after carry forward. All shares are worked out before any of them move.

openPoints.point: Metabolise shares that round down to 0
openPoints.assumption: Nothing moves or burns, for example LARVAL with q of 3 or less, or PUPAL with q of 1.

It stays until the next cycle's carry forward. The 'none' after cycle 5 is read as no extra carry forward, so the end amounts can be above their limits: chamber 2 ends at 10 (limit 8) and chamber 4 at 7 (limit 6).

openPoints.point: Moult threshold and when the total is measured
openPoints.assumption: The total is taken after metabolise, and the moult needs strictly more than 38. Cycle 5's total is exactly 38, so no moult.

openPoints.point: What goes into the loss tally
openPoints.assumption: Overflow discarded from chamber 6, LARVAL burn-off, chamber 1's PUPAL share, and the portion discarded at moult.
